Arabic

#Re-order data by words
arabic$words <- fct_inorder(arabic$words)

p4 <- ggplot(data = arabic, aes(x = ordered(words), y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Arabic Defining Set",
       y = "Bias Measure",
       x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "dodgerblue2", "firebrick2")) +
  expand_limits(y = c(-.3, 0.3))
p4 <- p4 + theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  text = element_text(family = "Gill Sans"),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
) 
p4
